h: Islamic cleric Sheikh Yahaya Masusuka reportedly shot dead by gunmen at his home in Katsina
p: Gunmen are said to have killed Sheikh Yahaya Masusuka at his home in Dutsin-Ma, Katsina State, in what is reportedly a targeted attack. Police are yet to say who carried it out or why. The militant group Ansaru has reportedly claimed responsibility, a claim that has not been independently verified.
more: The attack is said to have taken place at the cleric's residence.
Dutsin-Ma has seen repeated security incidents in recent months.
The Katsina state government has reportedly promised action over the killing.
